title: The data race Swift 6 refuses to build
prompt: This helper totals a list of amounts using a task group. It would run fine in a quick test, yet the Swift 6 compiler refuses to build it. Select the line that creates the data race.
hints: How many child tasks are running at the same time, and what are they all touching?
`Tally` is an ordinary class with a `var`. Is it `Sendable`?
In structured concurrency, children should hand results back to the parent rather than writing to shared state.
